saw_lines: Brands buy an AI video tool to test many variations, not one hero film, and judge each by its opening frames.
So the sale is decided in the first seconds, and a generic demo loses the buyer before the price appears.
Your 29 Google text ads carry lines like Symbol is not a constructor, which gives buyers no reason to click. Rewrite them around the $1 start and 1,000+ AI actors.
ads_1: Product in hand and talking actor videos, opening on the $1 start
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, X and Youtube
